title: Main Theme

request.prompt: contemporary playful soundtrack with a memorable hook, wonder, warmth, discovery, optimism and a little mischief, melody rises D-E-F#-A then falls B-A-F#-E, answered D-F#-A-B and A-E-F#-D, resolving home to D, harmony D6/9, G6, A add9, back to D6/9, syncopated 3+3+2 rhythm in 4/4, polished modern studio production, instrumental, D major, 124 bpm, glockenspiel lead, handbells, plucked strings, handclaps, bouncing bass, shimmering synths. A: glockenspiel states the hook over handbells. A': plucks and handclaps join, bass bounces. B: new answering phrase, fuller, joyful. A'': the hook returns, eases so it loops. No vocals, no lyrics, no singing, no humming, no 8-bit, no chiptune, no retro video-game music, no cheesy, no kazoo, no horror, no aggressive, no distorted guitar, no dubstep

trace.briefs_about: Briefs from docs/music/MUSIC_BIBLE.md (canon, Evan 2026-10-23): one Abbie's World identity (D major, 122-126 bpm, 4/4 with a 3+3+2 rhythm, the four-phrase hook over D6/9-G6-A(add9)-D6/9) arranged per world, plus the Mysterious / Intense / Epic gameplay modes and the sonic-identity stings. Text prompts can carry style, key, tempo and harmony; ElevenLabs cannot be made to play an exact melody, so the exact melody lives in tools/composer/motifs (MIDI + reference audio) and each take is judged against it. Until Evan picks the canonical melody, briefs describe the later hook (source_motif hook-late).
